factory.title: One factory, every machine
factory.description: Operating from a single, modern production facility in Vietnam, our team of engineers and technicians manufactures a full range of construction and agricultural machinery — all under one roof. Every machine is quality-checked before leaving the factory.
factory.text: Phu Long began as a local mechanical workshop more than twenty years ago. Today one production site in Giao Thuy, Ninh Binh, does everything from cutting and rolling steel to welding, painting, assembly and a test run before each machine is packed.
factory.text2: Because it all happens under one roof, we can change the drum size, the colour, the engine or the logo for each order, and mix several models in one container.

process.title: How a mixer is made
process.text: Every step happens in one factory, so we control the steel, the welds and the finish of each machine we ship.
process.cuttingText: Drum plates and frame parts are cut on our CNC cutting table.
process.machiningText: Shafts, bushings and gear parts are turned on the lathe.
process.weldingText: Robot and manual welding join the drum and the frame.
process.finishingText: Every weld is ground smooth before the machine is painted.
process.assemblyText: Drums, frames, engines and wheels come together in the main hall.
process.finishedText: Finished mixers are test-run and lined up for packing.
process.loadingText: Packed into FCL or LCL containers in our yard and shipped from Vietnam.

about.title: About Phu Long
about.subtitle: More than 20 years of building machines in one Vietnamese factory, for partners in 20 countries.
about.storyText: Founded over two decades ago, Phu Long Global Investment Co., Ltd has grown from a local mechanical workshop into a trusted export manufacturer with a global footprint. Operating from a single, modern production facility in Vietnam, our team of experienced engineers, designers, and technicians manufactures a full range of construction and agricultural machinery — all under one roof.
about.storyText2: We take pride in our ability to customize: from drum capacity and color to engine type and branding, every machine can be tailored to meet the specific requirements of our international partners. Today, our products serve customers in nearly 20 countries, backed by more than 70 satisfied clients worldwide.
about.factoryText: Our production facility is equipped with modern machinery and staffed by skilled engineers and technicians. From metal fabrication and welding to assembly and quality control, every step of manufacturing happens under one roof — giving us full control over product quality and delivery timelines.
about.cap1: Full-range manufacturing: construction machinery, farm machinery and industrial fans
about.cap2: OEM & custom orders: colors, logos, specifications
about.cap4: Strict quality control before every shipment
about.cap5: Export packaging: FCL and LCL container loading
about.exportsText: Our products are present in nearly 20 countries across Asia, Africa, and beyond. We work with importers, distributors, and direct buyers who trust Phu Long for consistent quality and reliable supply.
about.value1Text: Every machine is built to last and tested before shipment.
about.value2Text: We adapt to your market's needs — colors, engines, specs.
about.value3Text: 20 years of on-time delivery and after-sales support.
about.cap6: Industrial fans built to your airflow, pressure and material
